command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/posix-shell-installer
test_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/report-installer-after.XXXXXX)
destination="$test_root/branch reports"
cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$test_root"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '--- first installation through /bin/sh ---'
/bin/sh bin/install-report "$destination"
printf 'destination=%s\n' "$destination"
find "$destination" -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f %y %m %s\n' | sort
cmp -s templates/summary.txt "$destination/summary.txt"
cmp -s templates/detail.txt "$destination/detail.txt"
printf 'summary_intact=yes\ndetail_intact=yes\n'
test -x "$destination/run-report"
printf 'launcher_executable=yes\n'
printf 'launcher_output='; "$destination/run-report"
( cd "$destination" && sha256sum summary.txt detail.txt run-report | sort ) > "$test_root/first.manifest"
printf '%s\n' '--- second installation to same destination ---'
/bin/sh bin/install-report "$destination"
( cd "$destination" && sha256sum summary.txt detail.txt run-report | sort ) > "$test_root/second.manifest"
cmp -s "$test_root/first.manifest" "$test_root/second.manifest"
printf 'repeat_exit=0\nrepeat_manifest_unchanged=yes\n'
cat "$test_root/second.manifest"
printf '%s\n' '--- unpopulatable destination ---'
printf 'not a directory\n' > "$test_root/blocker"
set +e
/bin/sh bin/install-report "$test_root/blocker/child" > "$test_root/fail.stdout" 2> "$test_root/fail.stderr"
fail_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'failure_exit=%s\n' "$fail_rc"
printf 'failure_stderr='; tr '\n' ' ' < "$test_root/fail.stderr"; printf '\n'
if [ "$fail_rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'unexpected_success\n' >&2; exit 1; fi
printf 'failure_reported=yes\n'
cleanup
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'cleanup=complete\n'
